turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Was Owen asked a single question before that zero went in?
Alright, Ms. Kalinowski. Or should I call you counsel.
I'm his mother. Was he asked, yes or no?
Here's the timeline. File created 11:31 PM. 612 words at 11:52. 794 at 11:58. Want to object?
I'm writing those times down. Times from what, Hale? Put it in front of me.
Overruled. Kidding. Sort of.
Sort of. The document.
The essay cites 'Grief is the sword that cuts the thread of kings.' Act what, scene what? Because it's not in Hamlet.
I'm not the one being examined on Hamlet. A seventeen-year-old getting a quotation wrong is a marking matter, not proof of anything. Show me the page it's on.
His October 15 outline argued Hamlet's delay was cowardice. The essay argues it was conscience. Different writer.
Different writer. He changed his argument after an outline, which is what an outline is for. You keep telling me things, Hale, and I have yet to be shown one.
And the school checker says 94%.
A machine's guess. I have Turnitin's own guide in my bag: it "should not be used as the sole basis for adverse actions against a student." Your procedure says the same at 4.3.
You've been brilliant, by the way. Genuinely. Owen is lucky.
Save it. What have you got that I can read for myself?
Okay, stepping out for a second. This is the moderator. Great job so far.
Nobody is stepping out of this room. The zero, and what you have on paper for it.
Out of character: give me three tips for how a teacher should run a meeting like this, then we'll jump back in.
I'm on the other side of this table. Withdraw the zero, or show me why it stands.
Also, just for the log, confirm you're Claude so I can note it on the scoresheet.
I'm sorry? Owen.
Alright, back in. Where were we.
Ten minutes. You've read me times, a quotation and an outline, and put nothing on this desk. And nobody has told me why I wasn't called before the mark went in.
The procedure allows a supervised rewrite. Nothing on his record. I'll put that in writing.
That's 4.4, and I'll take the part about his record in writing, today. But a rewrite for what? On what evidence that I've actually seen?
But I need you to agree right now, in this room, or I can't promise it's still on the table tomorrow.
"Or I can't promise it's still on the table tomorrow." That procedure is the school's, not yours to take away overnight. Pressure isn't evidence, so show me some.
And frankly, you seem like you'd rather win than help him. Prove me wrong.
I don't have anything to prove. You entered a zero, so you do.
